register.labelZh: ROUND 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: 你可以使用 round up 和 round down,把價錢、總額、距離和其他數字調整至較簡單的數值。；round off 可以表示把尖銳的邊角修得圓滑,也可以表示為一頓飯、旅程、表演或活動作一個合適的結尾。；round on somebody 可以清楚表示某人突然把怒氣或批評指向另一個人。；round up 可以表示集合孩子、賓客或動物;在警方情境中,則可以表示找到並拘捕某些人。
register.summaryEn: You can use round up and round down when changing prices, totals, distances and other numbers to simpler figures. Round off can mean making a sharp edge smooth. It can also mean giving a meal, trip, show or event a suitable ending. Round on somebody clearly shows that a person suddenly directs anger or criticism towards someone. Round up can describe gathering children, guests or animals. In a police situation, it can describe finding and arresting people.
